Earlier, the Viacha health director, Rita Nebraska, had told local television that between 10 and 15 people were believed to have died in the incident, while 62 people were injured. Fourteen of the wounded were transferred to hospitals in La Paz, including a girl with third-degree burns, she said.
Police said more than 50 people were injured and dozens of homes damaged, largely by windows shattered in the blast.
Ambulances, medical teams and police were deployed to the military complex to assess the damage and evacuate the wounded to health centers.
Nebraska said firefighters had warned that a heat source remained at the site, raising the risk of another explosion, and urged residents to stay at least 150m away.

items.title: White Sox ride trio of homers to victory over Twins
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Colson Montgomery went 1-for-4 with a two-run home run, and the Chicago White Sox pulled away for a 4-1 win over the visiting Minnesota Twins on Friday night.
items.body:
Colson Montgomery went 1-for-4 with a two-run home run, and the Chicago White Sox pulled away for a 4-1 win over the visiting Minnesota Twins on Friday night.
Miguel Vargas and Braden Montgomery each hit solo homers for Chicago (74-67) in the opener of a three-game series. The AL Central-leading White Sox ended a two-game skid.
Josh Bell went 2-for-3 and homered to mark the lone run for Minnesota (67-74). Kody Clemens finished 3-for-4 for the Twins, who have dropped back-to-back games after winning three in a row.
White Sox right-hander Erick Fedde (8-8) defeated the Twins for the second time in less than a week. He held Minnesota to three hits in five scoreless innings, walked two and struck out two.
Twins right-hander Zebby Matthews (9-9) surrendered all four runs on four hits in five innings. He walked one and struck out four.
The defeat marked the first time in six starts that Matthews did not earn a victory.
The White Sox struck quickly in the bottom of the first inning. Matthews fired a fastball low and away, and Vargas took it the opposite direction for a homer to right-center field.
The blast marked Vargas' 30th home run of the season. His previous high was 16, which he set with the White Sox in 2025.
Braden Montgomery made it 2-0 with a blast in the second. He ripped a line-drive home run 419 feet to right-center field.
The power surge continued in the fourth as the White Sox increased their lead to 4-0. After Andrew Benintendi drew a one-out walk, Colson Montgomery hammered a towering, 416-foot homer into the right-center-field bleachers for his 30th of the season. His previous career high was 21, set last year as a rookie.
Bell put the Twins on the scoreboard in the ninth. He took right-hander Grant Taylor deep to right-center field for his 18th homer of the season.
Bell's homer and a double by Royce Lewis marked the Twins' only extra-base hits.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Chris Mueller, who once recorded brace for USMNT, retires
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Marking the end of an eventful career, Chicago Fire FC winger Chris Mueller announced his retirement from professional soccer on Friday.
items.body:
Marking the end of an eventful career, Chicago Fire FC winger Chris Mueller announced his retirement from professional soccer on Friday.
Mueller made an impression in two caps for the U.S. Men's National Team. He recorded a brace in the USMNT's 6-0 win over El Salvador in a friendly in 2020.
Mueller was diagnosed with pericarditis in 2025, which cost him the season. He returned for the Fire in February, making his debut in a preseason friendly against the LA Galaxy. He appeared in five regular-season games with one start.
"Goodbyes are never easy, especially when you're waving farewell to a game you've centered the last 20 years of your life around," Mueller said in a statement provided to the Fire. "With that being said, this has been a decision that hasn't come without real challenge, a hefty amount of consideration, and serious contemplation."
Mueller, 30, is a native of Illinois and joined the Fire in 2022, fulfilling a lifelong dream of suiting up for his childhood club. In 66 appearances over the next five seasons, Mueller tallied six goals and 10 assists.
"Thank you to the Chicago Fire, firstly, for bringing me home and allowing me to play for my childhood club," Mueller said. "And secondly, but more importantly, for their support throughout me battling through this diagnosis. Truly, it was unbelievable and I never felt alone in it.
"I'm beyond excited to see where the Club continues to head and for the victories that are yet to come. Thank you, Chicago. A supporter, I will always be."
Prior to joining Chicago, Mueller had stints with Orlando City (2018-21) and Hibernian F.C. of the Scottish Premiership (2022). His four-year run with Orlando resulted in 21 goals and 24 assists in 112 appearances.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Jared Jones fans 9 as Pirates blank Angels
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Jared Jones matched his season high with nine strikeouts over six three-hit innings and Jake Mangum had an RBI double to lead the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 1-0 victory over the visiting Los Angeles Angels in the opener of a three-game series on Friday night.
items.body:
Jared Jones matched his season high with nine strikeouts over six three-hit innings and Jake Mangum had an RBI double to lead the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 1-0 victory over the visiting Los Angeles Angels in the opener of a three-game series on Friday night.
Bryan Reynolds also doubled and had two hits for Pittsburgh (70-72), which won for the fifth time in its last six games. Konnor Griffin, activated off the 60-day injured list after missing 49 games with a torn sagittal band in his left ring finger, scored the lone run of the contest.
Jones (3-6) walked one while snapping a seven-start winless drought dating back to a 7-1 victory at Cleveland on July 18. He left after throwing a season-high 91 pitches, 63 for strikes.
Wilber Dotel followed Jones, recording two strikeouts and a walk over two innings, setting the stage for Mason Montgomery, who pitched around a leadoff single by Mike Trout in the ninth to pick up his ninth save.
Ryan Johnson (3-8) suffered the loss for Los Angeles (53-88) despite allowing just one run on four hits in six innings. He walked two and struck out six.
Pittsburgh scored the game's only run in the bottom of the second. Oneil Cruz led off with a walk but was erased at second on a fielder's choice by Griffin. Mangum then doubled into the right field corner, driving in Griffin, who barely beat the relay throw to the plate and avoided a sweeping tag attempt by catcher Moises Ballesteros with a headfirst slide.
Pittsburgh missed a chance to extend its lead in the eighth inning when it loaded the bases. Spencer Horwitz walked, advanced to second on Reynolds' single, and went to third when Nick Gonzales was hit by a pitch. But Angels reliever Samy Natera Jr. struck out Cruz to end the threat.
The Angels' best chance to tie it came in the ninth when Trout led off with a single to right. However, Wade Meckler popped out trying to sacrifice, Vaughn Grissom flew out to the warning track in right and Montgomery then struck out pinch-hitter Travis d'Arnaud to end the game.
--Field Level Media

items.title: White House reviews candidates to replace Hegseth deputy Feinberg, sources say
items.author: Mike Stone, Erin Banco, David Jeans
items.creator: Mike Stone, Erin Banco, David Jeans
items.summary: The White House has reviewed candidates to potentially replace Deputy Secretary of Defense Steve Feinberg, three people familiar with the discussions told Reuters, a sign that more leadership change could come for a Pentagon already facing unusually high staff turnover.
items.body:
The White House has reviewed candidates to potentially replace Deputy Secretary of Defense Steve Feinberg, three people familiar with the discussions told Reuters, a sign that more leadership change could come for a Pentagon already facing unusually high staff turnover.
The effort, which was under way in June, has included conversations with senior lawmakers in the Senate about whether the administration's picks would have enough support to be confirmed, said two of the people, one of whom added that the review was still going on as of late August. Reuters could not determine when the White House began considering candidates.
The three sources said no decision had been made to remove Feinberg from his post. They did not say why the White House was reviewing potential replacements and did not specify which candidates the White House was considering.
"These so-called anonymous 'sources' have no idea what they are talking about," said White House spokeswoman Anna Kelly.
"President Trump appreciates the work of Secretary Hegseth, Deputy Secretary Feinberg, and the entire Department of War, whose record of success in Operation Epic Fury, Operation Absolute Resolve, and Operation Midnight Hammer speaks for itself," she said, referring to U.S. military operations in Iran and Venezuela.
The Pentagon denied a process was under way to replace Feinberg. Asked for comment by Reuters, Hegseth said in a statement that Feinberg has his full support and “isn’t going anywhere.”
The Pentagon did not provide a comment from Feinberg and declined to make him available for an interview.
A departure by Feinberg, the billionaire co-founder of private equity firm Cerberus Capital Management, would be the most senior staff change for a department that has already seen a string of high-profile departures under Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth.
Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigned this week following months of tension with Hegseth, according to a source familiar with the matter. The Army has declined to comment on the reasons for his departure. Navy Secretary John Phelan and several senior Army leaders have also departed in recent months.
Feinberg, who vowed to accelerate U.S. munitions production, has not yet met that goal, according to analysts who say that the U.S. industrial base cannot ramp up quickly. Some defense industry executives say his task has been complicated by the slow pace of Congress appropriating funds despite [USN:L1N42V0TF TEXT:"immense pressure"] from the administration.
Feinberg "has worked tirelessly to rebuild our Defense Industrial Base and ensure our military has everything it needs to win, and I look forward to continuing to work with him," Hegseth said in his statement to Reuters, adding, "He’s doing a tremendous job for President Trump, for the Department, and for our warfighters."
FRUSTRATION OVER THE IRAN WAR Trump has increasingly expressed frustration with the lack of progress in the six-month-old Iran war, which has settled into a costly standoff between the U.S. and Iran.
One of the costs has been a drawdown of U.S. weapons stockpiles. Reuters has reported that the U.S. military faces [USN:L1N4410KB TEXT:"significant shortages"] of certain munitions, which have alarmed Congress and military leaders.
Trump has dismissed the concerns, saying the U.S. has "far more munitions than anyone in the world."
But in an exchange with Trump at Camp David earlier this month, according to the Washington Post, Hegseth blamed Feinberg for letting stockpiles of long-range guided missiles and air-defense interceptors shrink.
The White House has called the report "fake news." In a statement to Reuters, chief Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell said: "Secretary Hegseth did not mislead anyone about our munitions posture, and he did not blame Deputy Secretary Feinberg."
Appointed by Trump last year, Feinberg has attempted to reshape the Pentagon by ramping up the U.S. military's direct investments in companies and delivering loans to military contractors through multiple offices inside the department, including the Office of Strategic Capital and the newly created Economic Defense Unit.
In an August 18 memo he sent to defense firms and seen by Reuters, Feinberg called on contractors to speed up production and provide more transparency around pricing. The Pentagon did not respond to a question about the memo.
Feinberg has also come under scrutiny on Capitol Hill, where Democratic U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren has raised concerns about whether his former firm Cerberus could benefit from the Pentagon's spending on its Golden Dome missile defense program.
“There are no conflicts of interest between Deputy Secretary of War Steve Feinberg and Cerberus," said Parnell. "He has completely divested from Cerberus and has recused himself from any conversations or business relationships between the Executive Branch and Cerberus."
Cerberus did not respond to a request for comment.

items.title: テニス＝アルカラス、ストレート勝ちで4回戦進出　全米オープン
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　４日　ロイター］ - テニスの四大大会最終戦、全米オープン（ＯＰ）は４日、男子シングルス３回戦を行い、第２シードのカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）は呉易昺（中国）を６─３、６─４、６─１のストレートで下し、４回戦に進出した。

３度目の大会制覇を狙う２３歳のアルカラスは、四大大会での連勝記録を１７に伸ばした。昨年の全米ＯＰ優勝後、今年の全豪ＯＰを制して史上最年少で生涯グランドスラムを達成。今年の全仏ＯＰとウィンブルドン選手権は手首の負傷により欠場していた。

アルカラスは試合後、「苦しい場面でもアグレッシブかつ賢く、粘り強くプレーできた。とても満足している。もっと良くできる部分もあると思うが、全体的に今日のパフォーマンスはとても良かった。誇りに思う」と述べた。４回戦では、３回戦でアレクサンドル・ブブリク（カザフスタン）を下した第２０シードのトミー・ポール（米国）と対戦する。

そのほか、ロシア出身で第７シードのダニル・メドベージェフ、第１１シードのフランシス・ティアフォー（米国）、第２７シードのトマスマルティン・エチェベリ（アルゼンチン）らが３回戦を突破した。

items.title: EXCLUSIVE-アンソロピックのＩＰＯ、10月中旬に後ずれ＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Echo Wang

[４日] -
items.body:
Echo Wang

[４日] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックは、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）に向けたマーケティング開始が早くても１０月中旬となる見込みで、上場完了は１１月の米中間選挙の数日前になる見通しだ。複数の関係者が４日に明らかにした。

関係者によると、同社はこれまで、早ければ来週にもＩＰＯの目論見書を公開するとみられていた。目論見書の公開は、ＩＰＯ手続きの最終段階に入る重要なステップとなる。だが現在では、公開は９月下旬まで見込めないという。関係者は、時期を含む計画は変更される可能性があると注意を促した。

この変更により、一部の投資家が２兆ドル規模の評価額になる可能性を指摘するＩＰＯの時期が後ずれすることになる。

企業は市況や規制当局の審査、その他の準備を進める中でＩＰＯの日程を頻繁に調整するため、こうした変更は珍しいことではない。

関係者によると、アンソロピックはＩＰＯ手続きの一環として１５０億ドルのリボルビング・クレジット・ファシリティー（回転信用枠）の最終調整を進めており、その後、資金調達に関与する銀行を含むアナリストが同社と面談する見通しだ。 

企業は通常、アナリストとの面談からＩＰＯ目論見書の公開までに数週間の間隔を空けるが、アナリストがすでに同社を熟知しているため、アンソロピックの場合はこの期間が短くなる見込みだという。

アンソロピックはコメントを控えた。

投資家が急成長するＡＩ業界への投資機会を求めて公開市場に注目する中、今回のＩＰＯは史上最も注目される案件の一つになるとみられる。

関係者によると、モルガン・スタンレー、ゴールドマン・サックス、ＪＰモルガン、シティがアンソロピックのＩＰＯに関与する銀行に含まれている。

各行はコメントを控えた。

items.title: Pronóstico de crecimiento para México sube marginalmente previo a Paquete Económico 2027
items.author: Zenyazen Flores
items.summary: Las proyecciones para el peso mexicano se fortalecieron y para la inflación se mantienen estables hacia cierre de 2026, de acuerdo con la Encuesta Citi de Expectativas.
items.body: Ciudad de México — El pronóstico de crecimiento para la economía mexicana aumentó marginalmente para este año, mientras que las proyecciones para el peso mexicano se fortalecieron y para la inflación se mantienen estables hacia cierre de 2026, previo a la entrega al Congreso del Paquete Económico 2027 por parte de la Secretaría de Hacienda. La Encuesta Citi de Expectativas, publicada este viernes 4 de septiembre, mostró que la proyección mediana de crecimiento del Producto Interno Bruto (PIB) para 2026 subió a 1,3% desde 1,2% en la última encuesta, con un rango de estimaciones que va de 0,6% a 1,5%. Ver más: Paquete Económico 2027: ¿habrá más impuestos en México? Esto dicen los aliados de Sheinbaum Aunque los analistas consultados mejoraron su pronóstico para la economía hacia cierre de año, el estimado se queda por debajo del más reciente pronóstico de Banco de México (Banxico) , toda vez que el instituto central anticipa que el crecimiento del PIB se ubicará en 1,5%, con un intervalo de entre 1% y 2%. Los analistas de la Encuesta Citi prevén que para 2027 el crecimiento del PIB sea 1,8%, con un rango de estimaciones que va de 1% a 2,3%. Banxico prevé que para 2027 el crecimiento económico se sitúe en 2%, con un intervalo de entre 1,2% y 2,8%. Ver más: Sheinbaum anticipa que consolidación fiscal será “paulatina” en Paquete Económico 2027 La Secretaría de Hacienda enviará el martes 8 de septiembre el Paquete Económico 2027 en el que incluirá el Marco Macroeconómico con las proyecciones de las principales variables para 2026 y 2027, como es el PIB, el tipo de cambio, la inflación, la tasa de interés, el precio del petróleo y la plataforma petrolera. El estimado de crecimiento económico actual de la Secretaría de Hacienda es de entre 1,8% y 2,85 para cierre de este año y de entre 1,9% y 2,9% para 2027. Las expectativas para el peso se fortalecieron a unos días de que se conozca el Paquete Económico 2027 de la presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum. El consenso de los analistas de la Encuesta Citi de Expectativas espera que el tipo de cambio se ubique en MXN$17,50 por dólar al cierre de 2026, con expectativas que van de MXN$17 a MXN$18,75. Para finales de 2027, el consenso espera que el billete verde cotice en MXN$18,07, con expectativas que van de MXN$17,40 a MXN$19,10. Las proyecciones de inflación se mantuvieron en términos generales estables. Ver más: México impone cuotas compensatorias al acero laminado de China y Vietnam: ¿de cuánto serán? La proyección mediana para la inflación general al cierre de 2026 es de 4%; para el componente subyacente el pronóstico es de 4%. Para el cierre de 2027, la expectativa de inflación general se mantuvo en 3,80%, así como para el componente subyacente se mantuvo en 3,80%. El consenso de los analistas sigue anticipando que la tasa de política monetaria de Banxico no cambiará en el corto plazo. En la Encuesta Citi de Expectativas la mediana del pronóstico para la tasa de política monetaria a finales de 2026 se mantiene sin cambios en 6,50%, con estimaciones que van de 6,25% a 6,75%. Para finales de 2027, la expectativa también es de 6,50%, con estimaciones que van de 5,75% a 7,25%.

items.title: Ranger Suarez tosses 7 innings as Red Sox shut out Orioles
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Ranger Suarez fired seven sharp innings and Mickey Gasper homered in the first, lifting the Boston Red Sox to a 1-0 victory against the host Baltimore Orioles on Friday night.
items.body:
Ranger Suarez fired seven sharp innings and Mickey Gasper homered in the first, lifting the Boston Red Sox to a 1-0 victory against the host Baltimore Orioles on Friday night.
Suarez (6-4) limited the Orioles to five hits and one walk while striking out three across a 91-pitch effort. He won for just the second time in his past nine starts.
Garrett Whitlock and Aroldis Chapman each pitched an inning in relief to complete the shutout. Chapman notched his 32nd save, and second in as many nights, by working the ninth.
The Red Sox (77-65) earned their second victory in a row, but only their fourth in a 10-game stretch. The Orioles (69-73) took a fourth consecutive loss.
Gasper had two of Boston's five hits.
Orioles starter Shane Baz (5-15) lasted 6 1/3 innings, yielding one run on four hits and two walks. He struck out six in an unsuccessful bid for a second straight win following an 0-8 run in a 12-start stretch.
Blaze Alexander registered three of Baltimore's six hits, which were all singles. The Orioles left six runners on base but had only three batters go to the plate with a runner in scoring position.
Boston stranded 10 runners, going 0-for-7 with runners in scoring position.
Gasper was the game's second batter and he homered on a first-pitch fastball. His eighth long ball of the season was the only extra-base hit in the game.
The Red Sox threatened by loading the bases with two outs in the seventh inning on a single, a walk and a hit batter. However, reliever Alex Hoppe retired Adley Rutschman, the ex-Oriole who homered twice on Thursday in the series opener, on a flyout to end the scoring chance.
Josh Walker and Cam Sanders each pitched a shutout inning in relief for Baltimore, which would need to win the next two games in order to split the four-game series.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Trump grants clemency to 30 people, White House pardon czar says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump granted clemency this week to 30 people, including Emory Jones, a longtime associate of rap mogul Jay-Z, White House "pardon czar" Alice Marie Johnson posted on Friday.
items.body:
U.S. President Donald Trump granted clemency this week to 30 people, including Emory Jones, a longtime associate of rap mogul Jay-Z, White House "pardon czar" Alice Marie Johnson posted on Friday.
Jones served nearly 16 years in federal prison on drug charges, Johnson wrote in a social media post announcing the clemency actions.
The president took the action on Thursday, according to Johnson, the White House official responsible for organizing clemency efforts.
Jones was released in 2010 after Jay-Z wrote a letter to a judge on his behalf, seeking a sentence reduction.
Jones has worked as an executive at Jay-Z's Roc Nation entertainment company and co-founded the Paper Planes clothing brand.
The New York Times reported that other clemency recipients include a former Philadelphia union boss convicted of bribery and an ex-Navy sailor imprisoned for firearms offenses.
Trump has granted pardons of criminal convictions and commutations shortening sentences for [USN:L6N42H19B TEXT:"more than 1,700"] people since his second White House term began in January 2025.

items.title: Chris Sale, Braves top Cristopher Sanchez, Phils, boost NL East lead
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Chris Sale outdueled Cristopher Sanchez in a battle of aces and Mauricio Dubon hit a late two-run homer as the visiting Atlanta Braves topped the Philadelphia Phillies 5-2 on Friday.
items.body:
Chris Sale outdueled Cristopher Sanchez in a battle of aces and Mauricio Dubon hit a late two-run homer as the visiting Atlanta Braves topped the Philadelphia Phillies 5-2 on Friday.
Sale (14-9) allowed two runs and six hits in six innings, striking out seven and walking one. Sanchez (16-5) also tossed six innings, giving up three runs, five hits and three walks while fanning five.
Ronald Acuna Jr. had an RBI single as part of a 3-for-5 night for Atlanta, which earned its ninth win in 11 games.
Alec Bohm produced a solo homer and an RBI double for Philadelphia, which took its second straight loss after a six-game winning streak. Bryce Harper had his career-high on-base streak end at 35 games.
The Braves (84-57) increased their lead to five games over the second-place Phillies (79-62) in the National League East. The teams will play three more games in the current series, then three in Atlanta the following weekend.
Sanchez worked around a leadoff baserunner in the first inning, but he wasn't as fortunate in the following frame. Lane Thomas opened the second with a walk and advanced on Dubon's base hit. Two batters later, Austin Riley delivered an RBI single.
After a run-scoring groundout from Ha-Seong Kim, Acuna lined a base hit into center to put the visitors ahead 3-0.
Philadelphia promptly got one run back when Luis Arraez opened the bottom of the second with a single and Bohm hit the next pitch into left for an RBI double.
Bohm was back in the mix again in the fourth, lining a first-pitch fastball from Sale over the fence in left field to get the hosts within 3-2.
The Phillies had runners on second and third with two outs in the fifth, but Sale induced Harper into an inning-ending popout.
Sanchez concluded his night with a strikeout of Riley on his 108th pitch of the night, ending the sixth inning.
Atlanta added a pair of insurance runs in the eighth. Pinch hitter Mike Yastrzemski drew a one-out walk against Orion Kerkering before Dubon lifted a two-run homer to left-center, making it 5-2.
Raisel Iglesias was glad to accept the additional buffer, as the Atlanta closer struck out two in a perfect ninth inning for his 30th save.
--Field Level Media
items.raw_description: Chris Sale outdueled Cristopher Sanchez in a battle of aces and Mauricio Dubon hit a late two-run homer as the visiting Atlanta Braves topped the Philadelphia Phillies 5-2 on Friday.

items.title: Explosion at Bolivia military base kills at least 2, 14 missing, ministry says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: At least two people were killed and dozens injured on Friday after an explosion at a military barracks in the Bolivian municipality of Viacha, about 30 km (20 miles) from La Paz, Defense Minister Ernesto Justiniano said.
items.body:
At least two people were killed and dozens injured on Friday after an explosion at a military barracks in the Bolivian municipality of Viacha, about 30 km (20 miles) from La Paz, Defense Minister Ernesto Justiniano said.
His ministry said in a statement that 14 people were missing.
The blast occurred at around 2:30 p.m. (1830 GMT) in an area used to store pyrotechnic material, authorities said.
While the cause has yet to be established, officials said the blast originated from the defense ministry's fireworks stockpile.
Earlier, the Viacha health director, Rita Nebraska, had told local television that between 10 and 15 people were believed to have died in the incident, while 62 people were injured. Fourteen of the wounded were transferred to hospitals in La Paz, including a girl with third-degree burns, she said.
Police said more than 50 people were injured and dozens of homes damaged, largely by windows shattered in the blast.
Ambulances, medical teams and police were deployed to the military complex to assess the damage and evacuate the wounded to health centers.
Nebraska said firefighters had warned that a heat source remained at the site, raising the risk of another explosion, and urged residents to stay at least 150 meters away.

items.title: Wildfires spread near Indonesia's new capital, prompting calls for action
items.author: CNA
items.summary: The biggest of the fires in Nusantara was at a forest park at Bukit Suharto - or Suharto Hill - where around 300 hectares have burned.
items.body:

Wildfires spread near Indonesia's new capital, prompting calls for action

The biggest of the fires in Nusantara was at a forest park at Bukit Suharto - or Suharto Hill - where around 300 hectares have burned.

A firefighter sprays water in an attempt to extinguish a wildfire in Suharto Hill, North Penajam Paser in East Kalimantan province, Indonesia on Sep 3, 2026. (Photo: Reuters via Public Relations Office of the Nusantara Capital City Authority)

FAST

JAKARTA/NUSANTARA: Wildfires have begun spreading near Indonesia's under-construction new capital, prompting project authorities to urge the disaster mitigation agency to carry out cloud seeding and water-bombing operations, officials said.
Indonesia has intensified efforts to contain haze in six provinces hit the hardest by forest and land fires in Borneo and Sumatra islands, which so far have reached 73,311 hectares.
Wildfires have been raging in a number of spots on Borneo Island, but the eastern part, where the new capital, Nusantara , is located, has been relatively safe in the weeks since the fires began to worsen with the onset of the dry season in July.
Now, however, fires have spread to some areas around the capital, prompting the request for action from the authority overseeing the project, said Agus Riyanto, director for emergency response at the disaster mitigation agency.

Disaster response and mitigation teams in the Southeast Asian archipelago are facing the most challenging dry season in a decade, exacerbated by a "super El Nino" phenomenon.
The biggest of the fires in the new capital territory, Agus said, was at a forest park at Bukit Suharto, or Suharto Hill, named after the autocratic former president, where around 300 hectares have burned.
Bukit Suharto is around 50km from the city centre, which houses a number of major projects built over the last few years for the new capital.
In total, fires had burned around 400 hectares surrounding Nusantara as of Sep 2.

A drone view shows firefighters spraying water in an attempt to extinguish a wildfire in Suharto Hill, North Penajam Paser in East Kalimantan province, Indonesia on Sep 3, 2026. (Photo: Reuters via Public Relations Office of the Nusantara Capital City Authority)

NEW CAPITAL PLAN HAS FACED DELAYS President Prabowo Subianto's predecessor, Joko Widodo, announced a plan to build the US$32 billion Nusantara capital city project in 2019 to replace Jakarta, on the island of Java, which faces chronic congestion, floods and land subsidence.
But the project has faced delays and budget cuts since Prabowo took office in 2024.
Wisnubroto Sarosa, an urban and planning expert, said Nusantara was not an ideal location for the new capital as it was surrounded by forests and had limited water supplies, though the fire risk was less than in the western and central provinces of the island, which Indonesia shares with Malaysia and Brunei.
Indonesia has 53 aircraft currently carrying out water bombing and seeding activities. Japan has also sent over aircraft and personnel to assist, authorities said.
The disaster mitigation agency said a helicopter would be sent from neighbouring South Kalimantan to carry out water bombing around Nusantara.
Clouds in the area were still insufficient for seeding, but the disaster agency would do so when it was possible, Agus said.
Meanwhile, hundreds of Muslims gathered in front of the state palace in Nusantara to perform "Istisqo" prayers on Friday, asking for rain.
"We must seek God's forgiveness and if it's granted, Allah will send abundant rain," Rusdi Abdullah, the preacher, said.

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝シモンズが復帰へ、キングスと1年5.5億円で合意
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［４日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）で３度のオールスター選出を誇るベン・シモンズ（３０）が、キングスと１年３５０万ドル（約５億５０００万円）の契約で合意した。シモンズの代理人が４日、米スポーツ専門局ＥＳＰＮに明かした。

慢性的な背中の問題を抱えてきたシモンズは、治療とリハビリのため２０２５─２６年シーズンを全休。最後にプレーしたのは２５年４月で、クリッパーズでレギュラーシーズン１８試合に出場していた。

先月の報道では、シモンズは良好な状態で制限なく練習を行っており、ＮＢＡへの復帰を目指していると伝えられていた。また、２８年夏季五輪ロサンゼルス大会でオーストラリア代表として出場することも視野に入れているという。

１６年にセブンティシクサーズからドラフト全体１位で指名されたシモンズは、けがの影響でデビューが１年遅れたものの、１７─１８年シーズンに新人王を獲得。ただ１８─１９年シーズンを最後に度重なるけがに苦しみ、１シーズン５８試合を超える出場がない。

これまでのキャリアではセブンティシクサーズ、ネッツ、クリッパーズに所属し、通算３８３試合（うち先発３４４試合）に出場。１試合平均１３．１得点、７．４リバウンド、７．２アシスト、１．５スチールを記録している。

items.title: テニス＝サバレンカ、試合中に大麻のにおい訴え　全米ＯＰ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　４日　ロイター］ - テニスの四大大会最終戦、全米オープン（ＯＰ）で４日、ベラルーシ出身で女子世界ランキング１位のアリーナ・サバレンカが３回戦の試合中、コートに強い大麻のにおいが漂っているとして主審に訴える一幕があった。

サバレンカはカミラ・ラヒモワ（ウズベキスタン）との試合で自身のサービスゲーム中に「誰かが大麻を吸っている。とてもにおいが強いので、何とかしてもらえないか」と主審に申し出た。その後、試合は再開され、サバレンカはストレート勝ちを収めた。

試合後には「みんな好きなことをして、好きなものを吸って、好きなだけリラックスしてもいい。でもテニスコートの周りではやめてほしい」と笑顔でコメント。「ベストを尽くして戦おうとしている時に、あのにおいに対処するのは少し難しい」と話した。

全米ＯＰでは、過去にも選手が大麻のにおいについて不満を訴えている。会場内は禁煙だが、ニューヨーク州では２１歳以上の成人による嗜好用大麻の使用が合法で、周辺の公園などから煙が流れ込むことがある。

サバレンカはこれまでも大麻のにおいを感じたことはあるものの、試合中にあれほど強かったのは初めてと語り、「風もあったので、観客席からなのか、外からなのか分からない。もう少し配慮してほしい」と呼びかけた。

同じ時間帯にプレーしていた世界３位のジェシカ・ペグラ（米国）も「ニューヨークらしい混沌とした部分ではあるが、試合にほかの要素が入り込まないよう改善できることはあると思う」と語った。

items.title: テニス＝世界1位サバレンカが全米4回戦へ、複で穂積組と加藤組が初戦勝利
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　４日　ロイター］ - テニスの四大大会最終戦、全米オープン（ＯＰ）は４日、ニューヨークで女子シングルス３回戦を行い、ベラルーシ出身で世界ランキング１位のアリーナ・サバレンカがカミラ・ラヒモワ（ウズベキスタン）を６─３、６─４で下し、４回戦に進出した。

大会３連覇を狙うサバレンカは一度もブレークポイントを与えず、１０本のサービスエースを記録。「ここでは心地よくプレーできる。ニューヨークが大好きで、それが自分の家にいるように感じさせてくれるのだと思う」と語った。

４回戦ではテーラー・タウンゼント（米国）と対戦する。タウンゼントはロシア出身で第１５シードのディアナ・シュナイデルを６─２、６─７、６─３で退けた。

２０２４年大会準優勝で第３シードのジェシカ・ペグラ（米国）は、２１年大会準優勝のレイラ・フェルナンデス（カナダ）に１─６、６─４、６─３で逆転勝ち。第６シードのリンダ・ノスコバ（チェコ）は第２９シードのアン・リー（米国）に６─２、６─７、６─２で勝利した。

女子ダブルス１回戦では、穂積絵莉、アンドレヤ・クレパーチ（スロベニア）組がベラ・ペイン、サラ・シューメート（ともに米国）組に６─３、６─０で快勝した。

加藤未唯、呉芳嫺（台湾）組は第１２シードのテレザ・ミハリコバ（スロバキア）、オリビア・ニコルズ（英国）組に３─６、６─３、６─３で逆転勝ちし、２回戦に進んだ。

items.title: トランプ氏、訪米する習氏を国賓晩餐会でもてなし－9月24日開催
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は4日、中国の習近平国家主席が今月下旬にワシントンを訪問する際、習氏を歓迎する国賓晩餐会を開くと明らかにした。

トランプ氏は大統領執務室で記者団に対し、晩餐会を24日に開くと説明した。一方、中国とイランの関係をめぐる米中間の緊張については、問題視しない姿勢を示した。

トランプ氏は「国賓晩餐会を開く。中国とはすばらしい取り組みを進めている。これまでも中国とは非常にうまくやってきた」と述べた。

トランプ氏は「彼はすばらしい紳士で、われわれはとても気が合う。貿易関係も非常に良好だ。もちろん中国は競争相手でもあるが、習主席とは非常に良い関係にある」と述べた。さらに「彼は美しい妻と一緒に来る。彼女は美しく、すばらしい女性で、世界中から尊敬されている。2人で一緒に来る」と語った。

今回の訪問は、緊張と改善を繰り返してきた米中関係の新たな節目となる。両国は昨年、関税を巡る対立を激化させたが、その後はいわば貿易休戦で合意し、今年に入ってトランプ氏の中国訪問につながった。

中国はイラン産原油の最大の買い手となっている。トランプ氏はイランとの貿易停止を求めているが、中国は応じていない。トランプ氏はイランへの経済的圧力を強め、6カ月以上続く紛争の終結に向け、イランに合意を迫っている。

トランプ氏はイランに関し、「習主席には『関与しないでほしい』と伝えた。私は彼と非常に良い関係にある。中国は実際、それほど関与していない」と述べた。

items.title: Charlie Woods shoots 71, sits 4 back at Junior Players
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Charlie Woods put himself in contention at the Junior Players Championship on Friday, firing a 1-under-par 71 at TPC Sawgrass in Ponte Vedra Beach, Fla.
items.body:
Charlie Woods put himself in contention at the Junior Players Championship on Friday, firing a 1-under-par 71 at TPC Sawgrass in Ponte Vedra Beach, Fla.
The 17-year-old recorded five birdies and four bogeys on the par-72 Stadium Course in his lowest competitive round at the venue where his father, Tiger Woods, twice won the Players Championship.
Charlie Woods was tied for eighth when he finished shortly before 2 p.m. ET, minutes before weather halted play. After the round was completed, he was tied for ninth, four strokes behind leader Chase Bauer, who shot a 5-under 67.
Starting on the back nine, Woods overcame bogeys at Nos. 11 and 14 with consecutive birdies at Nos. 15 and 16. His most memorable escape came one hole later at the famous par-3 17th.
Woods pulled his tee shot toward the left side of the island green and initially thought the ball had gone into the water. Instead, it stayed dry on the footpath leading onto the green.
Faced with little room, Woods chipped to approximately 4 feet and converted the par putt.
"I was pleasantly surprised," Woods said of discovering his tee shot hadn't found the water.
He then rolled in an 18-foot birdie putt at No. 18 to make the turn at 1 under. Woods added birdies at Nos. 3 and 9 while mixing in two more bogeys over his final nine holes.
Friday's 71 continued a steady improvement for Woods at TPC Sawgrass. He tied for 31st at the event last year after rounds of 76, 75 and 72.
Tiger Woods won the Players Championship at the Stadium Course in 2001 and again in 2013. His first victory featured the famous 60-foot birdie putt at No. 17 in the third round.
Charlie Woods is scheduled to begin the second round from the first tee Saturday morning.
--Field Level Media

items.title: CVC Corp renegocia dívida e alonga vencimentos até 2029
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A CVC Corp anunciou nesta sexta-feira uma operação de renegociação de sua dívida, que prevê a redução do custo financeiro, alongamento de vencimentos e diminuição das saídas de caixa previstas para os próximos 12 meses.
items.body:
A CVC Corp anunciou nesta sexta-feira uma operação de renegociação de sua dívida, que prevê a redução do custo financeiro, alongamento de vencimentos e diminuição das saídas de caixa previstas para os próximos 12 meses.
A companhia possui aproximadamente R$400 milhões em dívida e já recebeu manifestações de intenção de cerca de R$200 milhões para adesão às novas condições, disse o grupo de agências de viagem em nota.
Com a nova estrutura anunciada, a remuneração das debêntures passa de um spread com CDI +4,5% para CDI +3,9%, enquanto os vencimentos, que atualmente estão concentrados em outubro de 2026 e abril de 2027, passarão para março e setembro de 2029.
Com isso, a companhia prevê efeitos sobre o fluxo de caixa. A CVC Corp disse que teria aproximadamente R$115 milhões em pagamentos previstos em outubro, considerando cerca de R$80 milhões de principal e R$35 milhões de juros. Para os debenturistas que aderirem à nova estrutura, a companhia disse que os juros serão incorporados ao principal e haverá amortização de 75% do valor original, reduzindo a necessidade de desembolso da companhia no quarto trimestre deste ano.
Para abril de 2027, a previsão é uma redução do desembolso de aproximadamente R$110 milhões nas condições atuais para cerca de R$25 milhões. Considerados os efeitos da operação nos próximos 12 meses, a CVC Corp estima uma redução de aproximadamente R$110 milhões nas saídas de caixa.
A nova estrutura também prevê o reforço das garantias vinculadas à operação, com os boletos dados em garantia aos debenturistas passando dos atuais R$72 milhões para aproximadamente R$130 milhões.
"Fazer isso em um cenário econômico ainda desafiador demonstra a confiança dos nossos parceiros financeiros e nos dá ainda mais flexibilidade para seguir executando a estratégia da companhia", disse Felipe Gomes, diretor financeiro da CVC Corp.

items.title: Former Cowboys running back Emmitt Smith is sued by investor over wind farm project
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: NFL career rushing leader Emmitt Smith is being sued by a Native American investment firm over claims that they misappropriated a US$2.5 million loan meant to fund a wind farm project in Texas.
items.body: NFL career rushing leader Emmitt Smith is being sued by a Native American investment company over claims that the former Dallas Cowboys running back and his business partners misappropriated a US$2.5 million loan that was supposed to fund a wind farm project in Texas. Kituwah LLC claimed in a lawsuit filed this week in Delaware that 4 13 Solutions used the money to repay an investor from previous dealings with Smith’s company. Kituwah seeks to invest in business opportunities for the Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians. Kituwah’s attorneys said Smith and the Pro Football Hall of Famer’s longtime business partner, David Mosley, misrepresented their efforts to secure a U.S. Department of Energy loan that would have triggered repayment to Kituwah. Kituwah claims the loan has accrued about $600,000 in interest and is asking a jury to determine damages. A message sent to 4 13 Solutions wasn’t immediately returned. There was no information on an attorney for Smith or his company in the filing. According to the lawsuit, Darrel Wilson of Wilson Holdings of North America LLC told Kituwah that he accepted a $2.5 million payment from Smith’s company and said he didn’t know what triggered the payment. Kituwah’s attorneys said it was, “Essentially, like a ponzi scheme.” Kituwah claims Wilson Holdings was supposed to be repaid only after the wind farm project between Austin and San Antonio, called Project Exodus, secured permanent financing. “Smith and Mosley knew this was improper,” the lawsuit said. “Instead of telling the truth, they represented to Kituwah that 4 13 Solutions had used the money to acquire Project Exodus as promised, but that the acquisition had been held up for one reason or another.” The lawsuit claims Smith and his partners never met the requirements for securing government funding and repeatedly made excuses for why the project wasn’t proceeding or stopped responding to requests. Kituwah said it delivered the funds on Sept. 1, 2023, with the expectation of being paid back within months. The lawsuit said 4 13 Solutions promised the wind farm would be operational by December 2024, but Kituwah had seen no evidence the project even existed just a month before that date. Kituwah said Smith and his partners claimed the wind farm project was valued at $396 million and would generate nearly $14 million in net income in its first year. The 57-year-old Smith spent the first 13 of his 15 seasons with the Cowboys, won three championships and was the MVP of Super Bowl 28. He broke Walter Payton’s rushing record in 2002 and finished with 18,355 yards.

items.title: Kennedy acknowledges one measles death in Pennsylvania
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: U.S. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr acknowledged on Friday that measles caused the recent death of an infant in Pennsylvania, citing information from a county coroner, but suggested the federal government would not yet recognize the fatality in official data amid a fast-growing national outbreak.
items.body:
U.S. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr acknowledged on Friday that measles caused the recent death of an infant in Pennsylvania, citing information from a county coroner, but suggested the federal government would not yet recognize the fatality in official data amid a fast-growing national outbreak.
Last month, Kennedy asked for [USN:L6N44U1B7 TEXT:"two measles-related deaths"] reported by Pennsylvania’s health department to be removed from the CDC’s national tally of measles, questioning whether the virus was the cause, Reuters reported. CDC staffers had already accepted the state’s characterization of the deaths as linked to measles before Kennedy's request.
Public health experts said the move amounted to extraordinary political interference in the authority of a state health department and an effort to minimize the risks of the highly infectious virus.
Kennedy posted on X on Friday that he was relying on information from the coroner in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, where the two deaths occurred.
“The Lancaster County Coroner has now publicly stated that measles caused only the second infant’s death and has also publicly stated that the infant had Amish lethal microcephaly,” Kennedy wrote on X. He said that babies with that condition typically live about 6 months and the infant was approximately 2-months-old at death.
The Lancaster coroner rejected the determination of the statewide health department that a second infant also died from measles, Kennedy said.
Kennedy said the CDC's health statistics agency still needed to receive and review records on measles deaths. At the moment, the national data does not reflect any measles deaths in 2026, he said.
The CDC updated its website on Friday with a note explaining that it was re-evaluating how it classified measles deaths. "This work is intended to promote consistent classification and reporting of measles deaths across jurisdictions,” the CDC website said without providing details on why reevaluation was required.
A spokesperson for the Health and Human Services Department, which oversees CDC, did not immediately respond to questions about recording either of the Pennsylvania deaths.
Neil Ruhland, a spokesman for the Pennsylvania Department of Health, reiterated on Friday that the state had confirmed two measles-related deaths in the state’s outbreak. He did not provide details on the deaths or comment on Kennedy’s remarks. The Lancaster coroner's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
U.S. measles cases have hit their highest level in more than three decades under President Donald Trump and Kennedy, his top health official and a long-time anti-vaccine activist. Kennedy has promoted the idea that vaccines, including the combined measles, mumps and rubella shot, are more dangerous than the diseases they prevent, despite decades of scientific evidence that the shots save lives.
Leading medical organizations say that Kennedy’s statements about vaccines and his policies as health secretary, including efforts to reduce the number of government-recommended childhood immunizations, have increased vaccine hesitancy, making outbreaks harder to curb.

Le Niger a accusé la France d'avoir incité des soldats mutins à attaquer la semaine dernière l'aéroport et la présidence à Niamey, la capitale du pays, déclenchant une riposte des forces loyalistes, selon un communiqué du gouvernement lu vendredi à la télévision.

"Une documentation conséquente a été constituée sur cette agression et le Niger se réserve le droit d'intenter des actions devant la justice internationale", indique le communiqué.

items.title: Shelton Shines, Tiafoe Triumphs: Thrilling US Open Battles Propel Stars Forward
items.summary: Ben Shelton overcame Denis Shapovalov's challenge to advance to the US Open fourth round after a grueling four-set match. Shelton now faces Stefanos Tsitsipas, while Frances Tiafoe continues his ...
items.body:
Shelton Shines, Tiafoe Triumphs: Thrilling US Open Battles Propel Stars Forward Ben Shelton overcame Denis Shapovalov's challenge to advance to the US Open fourth round after a grueling four-set match. Shelton now faces Stefanos Tsitsipas, while Frances Tiafoe continues his winning streak, setting up a clash with Daniil Medvedev. Both Americans aim for further success as the tournament progresses.
Devdiscourse News Desk | Updated: 05-09-2026 12:51 IST | Created: 05-09-2026 12:51 IST

Ben Shelton (Photo: Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Rising American tennis star Ben Shelton emerged victorious after a strenuous encounter with Canada's Denis Shapovalov in the US Open, securing his place in the fourth round. The tightly contested match saw Shelton prevail 7-6(3), 6-7(5), 6-2, 6-4, stretching into the early hours of Saturday as Shelton maintained his flawless record against Shapovalov in their ATP head-to-head meetings.
Shelton's resilience was on full display, particularly when the match's balance shifted in the first two sets, both decided by tie-breaks. With opportunities to serve out the second set at 5-4 and 6-5, Shelton faced fierce resistance from Shapovalov who forced a decider. However, Shelton regained momentum, leveraging Shapovalov's lapse in form to secure crucial breaks and dominate the latter part of the match.
Next up, Shelton will challenge former World No. 3 Stefanos Tsitsipas, fresh off a win over 18th seed Jiri Lehecka, while fellow American Frances Tiafoe continues his strong performance in New York. Tiafoe, marked by his commanding one-hour and 59-minute match against Valentin Vacherot, will face 2021 US Open champion Daniil Medvedev. The stage is set for high-stakes encounters as the tournament intensifies.

items.title: Court ruling temporarily restores eligibility for 2 Indiana defensive linemen
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A pair of key Indiana defensive linemen are eligible to play in Saturday's season opener after a state court temporarily blocked the NCAA and Big Ten from keeping them off the field.
items.body:
A pair of key Indiana defensive linemen are eligible to play in Saturday's season opener after a state court temporarily blocked the NCAA and Big Ten from keeping them off the field.
Monroe Circuit Court Judge Kara Krothe issued a temporary restraining order Friday, restoring eligibility for Stephen Daley and Kellan Wyatt, as well as six other college athletes who challenged NCAA rules that prevented them from competing during the 2026-27 academic year.
The ruling means Daley and Wyatt can rejoin No. 6 Indiana when the defending national champion opens its season at home against North Texas.
Krothe wrote that the athletes should be returned to the positions they held following their most recent college seasons, provided they would otherwise have qualified to compete with an additional year of eligibility.
"As long as they would have been eligible, academically and otherwise, to continue playing college sports in the following semester if they had a fifth year of eligibility, they are eligible today," Krothe wrote.
A hearing on the athletes' requests for a preliminary injunction is scheduled for Sept. 11, meaning Friday's ruling does not permanently settle the dispute.
Daley and Wyatt initially returned to Indiana in August, before their eligibility was once again called into question. On Aug. 21, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 10th Circuit stayed a separate ruling that had granted another season of eligibility to qualifying athletes from the high school Class of 2022 who were excluded from the NCAA's new eligibility framework.
Both players were important pieces of Indiana's defense during its 16-0 championship season.
Daley recorded 19 tackles for loss, 5.5 sacks and two forced fumbles in 13 games. A knee injury suffered in the postgame celebration following Indiana's 13-10 victory over Ohio State in the Big Ten championship game kept him out of the College Football Playoff.
Wyatt started seven games before a knee injury against Michigan State ended his season. He finished with eight tackles for loss and 2.5 sacks.
The other plaintiffs include Miami basketball player Malik Reneau; Indiana volleyball player Avry Tatum; Butler basketball player Yohan Traore; defensive back Jordan Johnson, who intends to play at Purdue, and Indiana swimmers Owen McDonald and Zalan Sarkany.
--Field Level Media

items.title: UN Urges Pakistan to Investigate Balochistan Man's Enforced Disappearance and Death
items.summary: UN human rights experts have called on Pakistan to investigate the enforced disappearance, torture, and killing of Imran Ali from Balochistan. Abducted in August 2025, Ali's body was misidentified and ...
items.body:
UN Urges Pakistan to Investigate Balochistan Man's Enforced Disappearance and Death UN human rights experts have called on Pakistan to investigate the enforced disappearance, torture, and killing of Imran Ali from Balochistan. Abducted in August 2025, Ali's body was misidentified and improperly handled. Authorities faced criticism for inadequate documentation and care of additional unidentified bodies.
Devdiscourse News Desk | Updated: 05-09-2026 12:48 IST | Created: 05-09-2026 12:48 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

United Nations human rights experts have urgently called upon Pakistan to conduct an independent and impartial inquiry into the enforced disappearance, torture, and extrajudicial killing of a Balochistan man named Imran Ali. The experts' appeal follows Ali's abduction from his residence on August 27, 2025, by approximately 20 operatives from Pakistan's Counter-Terrorism Department (CTD), as reported by the Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR).
Fellow detainees of Ali, upon their release, confirmed that he was subjected to several days of alleged torture while in custody. The case resurfaced during a hearing before Pakistan’s Commission of Inquiry on Enforced Disappearances on August 6, 2026. A police officer allegedly disclosed to the commission that Ali was killed in a so-called encounter in May 2026.
Authorities reportedly delayed identifying Ali's body by about a month, with claims that it could not be preserved. His family identified him from hospital photographs, leading to concerns about the handling of five other unidentified bodies brought to the hospital alongside Ali's. The experts have called for thorough forensic examinations, proper identification, and dignified return of Ali's remains to his family, emphasizing the necessity of a detailed investigation into the deaths amid a disturbing pattern of enforced disappearances in the region.

items.title: サッカー＝ＰＳＧ、ルイスエンリケ監督と2030年まで契約延長
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［４日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス１部、パリ・サンジェルマン（ＰＳＧ）は４日、ルイスエンリケ監督との契約を２０３０年まで延長したと発表した。５選手とも新契約を結んだ。

スペイン代表やバルセロナの監督を歴任したルイスエンリケ氏は２３年にＰＳＧの指揮官に就任。欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）２連覇、フランス１部３連覇など、クラブ史上最も成功した時期に采配を振るっている。

２５年には６冠を達成し、米国で開催されたクラブワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）でも決勝に進出した。

同クラブはジョアン・ネベス、ウィリアン・パチョ、ルーカス・ベラウド、下部組織出身のセニー・マユルとも３１年まで契約を延長した。

ネベスは２４年にベンフィカ（ポルトガル）から加入後、ＰＳＧで１００試合に出場。パチョも同年にアイントラハト・フランクフルト（ドイツ）から加入し、１０５試合に出場している。ベラウドは２４年１月にサンパウロ（ブラジル）から移籍。

また、ファビアン・ルイスとは１年の延長オプション付きで２８年まで契約を更新。２２年にナポリ（イタリア）から加入し、ＰＳＧでは１７１試合で１６得点、２８アシストを記録している。

items.title: サッカー＝イプスウィッチ前田が先発、リバプール遠藤出番なし　プレミア
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［イプスウィッチ（英国）　４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［イプスウィッチ（英国）　４日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは４日に１試合を行い、前田大然が先発したイプスウィッチはホームでリバプールに０─２で敗れた。

イプスウィッチは前半６分、ペナルティーエリア右でパスを受けたアレクサンデル・イサクに鋭いシュートでネットを揺らされ、失点。同９分にもイサクにゴールを奪われた。前田は後半２１分に交代。リバプールの遠藤航はベンチスタートから出番がなかった。

リバプールの主将フィルジル・ファンダイクは試合後、スカイスポーツに対し、「良いパフォーマンスだった。素晴らしいパスを２本出したコディ（・ハクポ）は傑出した活躍を見せた。いい勝利だったし、ここから次戦に向けて照準を合わせたい」と、２アシストのハクポを称えた。

アンドニ・イラオラ監督の新体制で初白星を手にしたリバプールは、今季リーグ開幕から１勝２分けの無敗に。イプスウィッチは１勝２敗となっている。

items.title: バスケットボール＝女子Ｗ杯、日本が逆転でマリに勝利
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［４日　ロイター］ - バスケットボール女子のワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）は４日、ベルリンで開幕し、１次リーグＡ組の日本はマリに１０２─９７で逆転勝ちし、白星発進した。

日本は前半を４８─５２で折り返し、第３クオーター終了時点でも７１─７３とリードを許したが、第４クオーターで逆転。残り４分２８秒に林咲希が３点シュートを決めて８７─８５と勝ち越すと、その後は一度もリードを譲らなかった。

林は３点シュート１５本中９本を成功させ、両チーム最多の２７得点をマーク。日本はチーム全体でも３点シュート３５本中２０本を成功させた。田中こころは１８得点、７アシスト、高田真希は１４得点を記録した。

このほか、Ａ組ではスペインが開催国ドイツに８３─５３で快勝。Ｂ組は韓国がナイジェリアを９９─８１、フランスがハンガリーを９９─５３で下した。Ｃ組ではオーストラリアがプエルトリコに７０─５４、ベルギーがトルコに８９─７５で勝利。Ｄ組は米国が中国に９４─６１、イタリアがチェコに６３─５４で勝った。

items.title: サッカー＝レアルがベティスに敗戦、今季初黒星　エムバペがＰＫ失敗
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［セビリア（スペイン）　４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［セビリア（スペイン）　４日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部は４日に１試合を行い、レアル・マドリードは敵地でベティスに０─１で敗れ、今季初黒星を喫し、開幕４連勝を逃した。

レアルは後半３６分に失点。ＧＫティボー・クルトワがはじいたボールを押し込まれた。その４分後には、キリアン・エムバペが決定機を迎えたが、シュートはクロスバーを直撃。さらに途中出場のカルロス・エスピがビニシウス・ジュニオールのクロスにオーバーヘッドで合わせてネットを揺らしたが、ビデオ・アシスタント・レフェリー（ＶＡＲ）の判定でオフサイドとなり、得点は認められなかった。

アディショナルタイムには、ビニシウスがペナルティーエリア内で倒され、レアルはＰＫを獲得。しかしエムバペのキックは相手ＧＫにセーブされ、同点のチャンスを生かせなかった。

レアルのジョゼ・モウリーニョ監督は「どうして負けたのか分からない。チームとして非常にいいプレーをした。選手たちの姿勢を責めることはできない。勝利に値する内容だったが、それに値するというだけでは勝ち点は得られない」と話した。

items.title: Deputado do partido governista mexicano é encontrado morto com ferimento à bala
items.author: Lizbeth Diaz
items.creator: Lizbeth Diaz
items.summary: Um deputado federal do partido Morena, atualmente no poder no México, foi encontrado nesta sexta-feira morto com um ferimento à bala no Estado de Veracruz, no leste do país, a menos de um ano das eleições locais e federais.
items.body:
Um deputado federal do partido Morena, atualmente no poder no México, foi encontrado nesta sexta-feira morto com um ferimento à bala no Estado de Veracruz, no leste do país, a menos de um ano das eleições locais e federais.
Zenyazen Escobar, parlamentar federal que representava o Estado litorâneo onde se encontram alguns dos complexos petrolíferos do país, foi encontrado morto dentro de seu carro com pelo menos um ferimento à bala.
“O inquérito está sendo montado”, disse a procuradora-geral do Estado, Lisbeth Jiménez, sem fornecer detalhes.
O secretário-geral de Veracruz, Ricardo Ahued, afirmou que o veículo do parlamentar não apresentava sinais de violência.
A Câmara dos Deputados do México expressou suas condolências à família e aos amigos de Escobar e instou autoridades a conduzirem uma “investigação minuciosa dos fatos”.
A morte ocorreu enquanto o país se prepara para eleições, em 6 de junho, para renovar cargos de prefeito, deputado estadual, vereador e governador.
Em eleições anteriores, diversas regiões sofreram incidentes de violência ligados a grupos do crime organizado que buscavam cooptar figuras políticas e consolidar o controle territorial.
De acordo com a organização de direitos humanos Data Cívica, somente em julho ocorreram pelo menos 30 incidentes de “violência político-criminal” em 11 Estados do México, sendo 14 deles homicídios.
Os Estados com o maior número de casos registrados foram Zacatecas, com 10 casos; Michoacán e Quintana Roo, com quatro cada; Oaxaca, com três; e Baixa Califórnia e Veracruz, com dois cada.
A Data Cívica descreve a violência político-criminal como ameaças, homicídios, ataques armados, tentativas de assassinato, desaparecimentos e sequestros.
O órgão eleitoral nacional, o INE, alertou que o crime organizado representa uma das preocupações mais sérias para os processos democráticos.
Segundo o INE, decisões judiciais já documentaram, no passado, a presença de indivíduos armados com o objetivo de intimidar ou coagir o público a votar de determinada maneira, assim como atos de furto e incêndio de material eleitoral.

items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 世界的な債券売りが進んでいるが、ウォール街を揺るがすほどの打撃にはなっていない。資金調達コストの見直しは進んでいるものの、通常ならみられるリスク資産からの資金逃避にはつながっていない。

4日には市場の底堅さが改めて試された。予想を上回る米雇用統計を受け、市場では米連邦準備理事会（FRB）が15－16日の連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）会合で利上げに踏み切るとの観測が強まり、米国債は売られた。ドルは再び上昇したほか、S&P500種株価指数は下落して引けたが、週間ではプラスを確保した。ナスダック100指数も週間ベースで上昇した。

注目すべきは、債券市場の混乱が他の市場にほとんど波及していない点だ。信用スプレッドは低水準を維持し、リスク資産の下落に備えるヘッジコストもなお比較的低い。市場機能の悪化も一部にとどまっている。JPモルガン・チェースによると、米国債市場の流動性が急速に悪化している一方、株価指数先物や社債の上場投資信託（ETF）では米国債市場に匹敵するようなストレスがほとんどみられない。

力強い経済成長と企業利益が、市場を金利上昇の影響から守る大きな支えとなっている。AI主導の色彩がますます濃くなっている市場では、投資ブームをけん引する企業が巨額の投資計画を進められるだけの利益を上げ、投資家も引き続き資金を提供する姿勢を示している。一方、貿易ショックやイラン紛争による相場変動でも、資産を持ち続ける戦略が繰り返し報われてきた。

シュワブ金融調査センターの債券調査・戦略責任者コリン・マーティン氏は「金融環境は依然として緩和的で、信用スプレッドも驚くほど低い水準にとどまっている」と指摘。「企業利益が前年同期比で20%を超える伸びを示している状況では、足元の企業借り入れコストを企業がそれほど懸念しているようにはみえない」と述べた。

JPモルガンも、資金の価格と供給状況の間に同様の乖離（かいり）があると分析する。借り入れコストは急上昇したが、融資や信用創造はそれに伴って縮小していない。米銀の融資はなお増加傾向にあり、米投資適格企業による社債の純発行額も8月に増えたという。

items.title: DeepSeek planea instalar 160.000 chips Huawei en un megacentro para reducir su dependencia de Nvidia
items.author: Mackenzie Hawkins, Haze Fan
items.summary: La startup china planea usar los aceleradores Ascend 950DT de última generación de Huawei en un centro de datos en Mongolia Interior, aunque la escasez de componentes podría retrasar la instalación.
items.body: Bloomberg — DeepSeek tiene previsto instalar al menos 160.000 de los mejores aceleradores de Huawei Technologies Co. en un gigantesco centro de datos que está construyendo en Mongolia Interior, lo que podría dar lugar a uno de los mayores clústeres conocidos de chips de IA de Huawei e impulsar los esfuerzos de China por sustituir a Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ). Esta empresa pionera en IA tiene la intención de utilizar los chips Ascend 950DT de última generación de Huawei para el funcionamiento de sus modelos, aunque el calendario de instalación dependerá de la capacidad de producción de Huawei, según fuentes familiarizadas con el asunto. La startup no tiene previsto, por el momento, utilizar los chips 950DT para el entrenamiento, según señala una de las fuentes, a pesar de que Huawei diseñó y comercializó estos procesadores precisamente para desempeñar esa función más exigente. Aunque DeepSeek intentó entrenar sus modelos anteriores con chips de Huawei, hasta ahora ha recurrido a los aceleradores de Nvidia para este paso crucial. Ver más: Nvidia invertirá US$3.500 millones en MediaTek para ampliar su alianza en chips de IA DeepSeek desea adquirir más unidades de los mejores chips de Huawei, según estas fuentes, pero el líder chino en semiconductores no dispone actualmente de la capacidad de producción necesaria. La escasez de componentes, como la memoria de gama alta, limitará la producción de Huawei del modelo 950DT a unas pocas cientos de miles de unidades este año, según afirmó una de las fuentes. Huawei está equilibrando la demanda de otros clientes e intentando exportar pequeños volúmenes al extranjero, por lo que satisfacer el pedido de DeepSeek podría llevar más de un año, según indicaron las fuentes, que hablaron bajo condición de anonimato para abordar un acuerdo confidencial. Si se completa según lo previsto, el centro de Mongolia Interior será clave para impulsar el desarrollo de la IA en DeepSeek, que se encuentra en negociaciones para recaudar miles de millones de dólares con el fin de ampliar su infraestructura. Ver más: Tokens baratos, chips caros y el gran problema de la rentabilidad de la IA La instalación eclipsaría a otros clústeres conocidos públicamente de procesadores Ascend de Huawei, lo que supone un paso significativo en el intento de China de dejar de depender de los componentes de Nvidia. Para cuando entre en funcionamiento, según una persona con conocimiento de las capacidades de producción de Huawei, China podría contar con varios clústeres de ese tamaño. DeepSeek no respondió a las solicitudes de comentarios y un portavoz de Huawei no hizo declaraciones de inmediato. Más de cien mil chips en una sola instalación situarían las ambiciones de DeepSeek al nivel de los centros de datos que las empresas occidentales construyen habitualmente en la actualidad —aunque los de China estarían equipados con procesadores de menor capacidad—. Los aceleradores de Nvidia son el estándar mundial para el entrenamiento y la ejecución de modelos de IA, pero su venta a China está en gran medida prohibida sin permiso de EE.UU. Huawei es una de las pocas empresas fundamentales para el objetivo de Pekín de dominar la IA a pesar de las restricciones estadounidenses. El gigante de las telecomunicaciones con sede en Shenzhen se ha erigido como el líder nacional de facto en la fabricación de chips del país asiático, mientras que DeepSeek, con sede en Hangzhou, ha sentado las bases para el lanzamiento de modelos de IA disruptivos, un modelo que desde entonces han seguido empresas como Moonshot. Ver más: Amazon comprará dos millones de chips de Nvidia para sus centros de datos La capacidad de China para producir —y, en última instancia, exportar— sus propios chips de IA es uno de los factores determinantes de su competencia tecnológica con EE.UU. Se trata de un indicador que los responsables políticos estadounidenses siguen muy de cerca, y que les ha llevado a imponer restricciones durante años a empresas como Huawei con el fin de frenar ese progreso. Esas restricciones han limitado la producción y el rendimiento de Huawei. Bloomberg News informó el año pasado de que Huawei tiene previsto fabricar alrededor de 1,6 millones de chips Ascend en 2026: componentes básicos suficientes para unos 600.000 de los emblemáticos chips 910C de la empresa, además de una pequeña cantidad de otros modelos. Presentado hace aproximadamente un año, el 950DT es una versión mejorada y más potente que, en general, se considera comparable en potencia a la anterior generación de chips Hopper de Nvidia. Aun así, incluso la posibilidad de un clúster de 160.000 chips supone un avance. Hace apenas seis meses, un periódico oficial del centro tecnológico de Shenzhen informó de que se había puesto en marcha el primer clúster de computación inteligente de 10.000 chips del país, utilizando la serie Ascend de Huawei —una instalación minúscula en comparación con los centros de datos de Estados Unidos—. SpaceXAI, de Elon Musk, puso en funcionamiento en 2024 un clúster diez veces mayor. Ver más: Huawei le ofrece a Egipto sus chips de IA, y EE.UU. prepara una contraoferta con Nvidia y Microsoft En junio, el gigante chino de reparto de comida a domicilio Meituan anunció que había entrenado un modelo de IA utilizando 50.000 chips de fabricación nacional, sin ofrecer más detalles. La empresa Z.AI Co. completó en julio la construcción de un centro de datos de 1 gigavatio que tiene previsto equipar exclusivamente con chips de fabricación china, aunque su parque instalado actual es reducido, del orden de 10.000 tarjetas. Nvidia, con sede en San José (California), se ha quejado de que esta transición hacia el silicio de fabricación propia en China es la consecuencia natural de años de controles de exportación por parte de EE.UU., que Washington impuso por primera vez en 2022 ante la preocupación de que los chips de IA estadounidenses pudieran potenciar el ejército chino. De hecho, Pekín está instando a los laboratorios de IA chinos a que cambien a hardware nacional, un esfuerzo que algunos están acogiendo con más entusiasmo que otros. No obstante, el sector privado chino sigue prefiriendo los chips de Nvidia, como demuestran los grandes pedidos de empresas como Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. ( BABA ) y Tencent Holdings Ltd. tras la flexibilización de las restricciones de Washington por parte del presidente de EE.UU., Donald Trump. Ver más: OpenAI asegura que sus nuevos chips superan a Nvidia en pruebas de rendimiento Además, las empresas chinas siguen pudiendo acceder a cantidades ingentes incluso de los mejores chips de Nvidia alquilando potencia de cálculo ubicada en el extranjero, lo que, por lo general, no infringe las normas estadounidenses. Washington también ha acusado a empresas como Moonshot y DeepSeek de utilizar hardware de Nvidia de contrabando para impulsar su desarrollo en inteligencia artificial. No obstante, el gobierno central chino se mantiene bastante firme: mientras que el equipo de Trump estaba dispuesto a permitir la venta de hasta un millón de chips Nvidia H200 —el modelo estrella de una generación anterior de Nvidia—, Pekín solo ha dado luz verde hasta ahora a la importación de una fracción de ese total. DeepSeek es una de las varias empresas chinas que han optimizado sus modelos para que funcionen con aceleradores nacionales. La empresa ha solicitado la ayuda de Pekín para convencer a Huawei de que asigne más chips a la startup —y con mayor rapidez—, según ha indicado una de las fuentes. Ver más: ¿Es momento de invertir en acciones de semiconductores? BofA señala los pros y contras El Ministerio de Industria y Tecnología de la Información de China, que supervisa la política tecnológica nacional, no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios enviada por fax. Los objetivos de DeepSeek en materia de infraestructura de IA en Mongolia Interior se sitúan a escala de gigavatios, lo que, a pleno rendimiento, consumiría suficiente energía para abastecer a unos 750.000 hogares. Los 160.000 chips Ascend 950DT que DeepSeek tiene previsto instalar allí constituirían solo una parte de esa capacidad. No está claro qué tipos de chips tiene previsto utilizar el laboratorio de IA para el resto. Funcionarios de la administración Trump han alegado que la startup ha adquirido los chips Blackwell de gama alta de Nvidia y los ha instalado en Mongolia Interior, una afirmación que Bloomberg no ha verificado de forma independiente. -Con la colaboración de Gao Yuan y Dong Lyu. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Equador diz que afundamento de embarcações pelos EUA fazia parte de investigação conjunta contra tráfico de drogas
items.author: Alexandra Valencia, Yury Garcia
items.creator: Alexandra Valencia, Yury Garcia
items.summary: O Equador defendeu nesta sexta-feira as operações dos EUA que interceptaram e afundaram três embarcações equatorianas nesta semana, enquanto parentes de alguns tripulantes afirmaram que os homens eram pescadores e acusaram Washington de agir sem provas.
items.body:
O Equador defendeu nesta sexta-feira as operações dos EUA que interceptaram e afundaram três embarcações equatorianas nesta semana, enquanto parentes de alguns tripulantes afirmaram que os homens eram pescadores e acusaram Washington de agir sem provas.
O episódio é o mais recente de uma campanha cada vez mais ampla dos EUA contra o tráfico marítimo de drogas no Pacífico oriental, que tem gerado críticas de grupos de direitos humanos e preocupação na América Latina quanto ao uso de força letal no mar.
Os familiares contestaram a versão oficial. A esposa de um tripulante, que se identificou como Rosalba, de 47 anos, sem revelar o sobrenome, disse por telefone que os homens estavam pescando quando foram abordados e que nenhuma droga foi encontrada.
“Não entendo por que o governo dos EUA tem que agir de forma tão arbitrária”, disse ela, acusando-o de violar os direitos humanos dos pescadores.
Ela afirmou que a embarcação transportava apenas peixes e alegou que foi atingida em águas equatorianas, e não internacionais. A Reuters não conseguiu verificar de forma independente a versão dela.
O governo do Equador afirmou que a operação foi resultado de investigações conjuntas com Washington, visando a logística do contrabando de drogas ligada a gangues criminosas.
“Este é um trabalho realizado por meio da cooperação internacional”, disse o ministro do Interior, John Reimberg, à emissora Teleamazonas, acrescentando que as embarcações serviam como pontos flutuantes de reabastecimento que ajudavam lanchas a transportar drogas para o norte, em direção ao México e aos Estados Unidos.
O Comando Sul dos EUA afirmou que as embarcações afundadas nesta semana estavam sendo usadas como postos de reabastecimento para o tráfico de drogas e disse que elas estavam ligadas à gangue Los Choneros. Um vídeo divulgado pelos militares mostrou imagens em preto e branco de agentes se aproximando e abordando uma embarcação antes de ela ser explodida no mar. A Reuters não conseguiu verificar de forma independente a data e o local das imagens.
A Marinha do Equador informou que 28 tripulantes de duas embarcações — nove do Conquista 2 e 19 do OM2 — chegaram a Manta às 15h (horário local), a bordo de uma embarcação da guarda costeira. Outros oito tripulantes do Conquista 2 ainda estavam retornando ao porto a bordo de outra embarcação.

items.title: Niger blames France for inciting soldiers' mutiny
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Niger has blamed France for inciting an attack on a key military airbase by mutinous soldiers last week, according to a government statement read on TV on Friday.
items.body:
Niger has blamed France for inciting an attack on a key military airbase by mutinous soldiers last week, according to a government statement read on TV on Friday.
Mutinous soldiers in the West African country attacked the airport and the presidency in the capital, Niamey, [USN:L1N44Q00F TEXT:"on August 29"], the latest threat to the rule of Abdourahamane Tiani, who seized power in a 2023 coup.
Explosions and gunfire also rang out at a military airbase, but Niger's army, backed by Russian paramilitary forces, regained control over it the next day.
The Council of Ministers on Friday concluded that the attack had been incited by a vast network of accomplices led by France, according to the statement.
"A substantial body of evidence has been compiled regarding this attack, and Niger reserves the right to bring the matter before international courts," the government said in the statement.
The attack highlighted tensions within Niger's armed forces, which have suffered repeated battlefield losses while fighting a jihadist insurgency.
Tiani blamed France and other West African countries for unrest in the capital [USN:L1N3YU00A TEXT:"earlier this year"], without providing evidence.

items.title: Ｆ１＝イタリアＧＰフリー、角田が10番手　最速はラッセル
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［モンツァ（イタリア）　４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［モンツァ（イタリア）　４日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１のイタリア・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は４日、フリー走行を行い、レーシングブルズの角田裕毅は２回目で１０番手だった。メルセデスのジョージ・ラッセル（英国）がトップタイムを記録した。

角田は午後のフリー走行２回目で１分２３秒４５５をマークし、ラッセルから０秒８９６遅れ。１回目はトップから１秒５６３差の１２番手だった。

ラッセルは２回目に１分２２秒５５９を記録。フェラーリのシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）が０秒１２０差の２番手、個人総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（メルセデス、イタリア）が０秒１４１差の３番手で続いた。

昨季王者で直近２戦を連勝しているマクラーレンのランド・ノリス（英国）は４番手。フェラーリのルイス・ハミルトン（英国）が５番手、マクラーレンのオスカー・ピアストリ（オーストラリア）が６番手だった。

１回目はルクレールが１分２３秒００８で最速。ハミルトンが０秒１７３差の２番手となり、フェラーリ勢がワンツーを占めた。ラッセルは３番手だった。

items.title: Phillies 3B Bryson Stott (personal matter) scratched vs. Braves
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Philadelphia infielder Bryson Stott was scratched from the Phillies' lineup shortly before first pitch against the visiting Atlanta Braves on Friday due to a personal matter.
items.body:
Philadelphia infielder Bryson Stott was scratched from the Phillies' lineup shortly before first pitch against the visiting Atlanta Braves on Friday due to a personal matter.
The Phillies didn't immediately provide a reason for Stott's removal. However, Stott and his wife, Dru, announced in May that Dru would be giving birth to a girl in September.
While not divulging the reason for Stott's absence, Phillies interim manager Don Mattingly said after the game the team learned that Stott would miss the game about an hour before first pitch. Mattingly added that he did not know if Stott would be available Saturday.
Stott was slated to bat seventh and play third base. Edmundo Sosa moved from left field to third and Bryan De La Cruz started in left and batted seventh against Braves starter Chris Sale. The Braves won the game 5-2.
Stott, 28, is batting .255 with 10 homers, 61 RBIs and 24 stolen bases in 134 games this season. Over five seasons, he has a .256 average, 59 homers, 295 RBIs and 123 steals in 707 games.
--Field Level Media
